gaps.text: Combining several spectroscopy methods (data fusion) (Low-level fusion: synchronised NIR and Raman spectra merged into one augmented matrix before PLS modelling, as in the published feed-frame example. Both probes must sample the same powder volume at the same time step, with block scaling so neither method dominates. The fused model must beat the best single method on held-out batches, otherwise the extra instrument is dropped.)
